original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-finite-twisted}
Let $f : Y \to X$ be a finite pseudo-coherent morphism of schemes
(a finite morphism of Noetherian schemes is pseudo-coherent).
The functor $R\SheafHom(f_*\mathcal{O}_Y, -)$ maps
$D_\QCoh^+(\mathcal{O}_X)$ into $D_\QCoh^+(f_*\mathcal{O}_Y)$.
If $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, then the diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
D_\QCoh^+(\mathcal{O}_X) \ar[rr]_a \ar[rd]_{R\SheafHom(f_*\mathcal{O}_Y, -)}
& & D_\QCoh^+(\mathcal{O}_Y) \ar[ld]^\Phi \\
& D_\QCoh^+(f_*\mathcal{O}_Y)
}
$$
is commutative, where $a$ is the right adjoint of
Lemma \ref{lemma-twisted-inverse-image} for $f$ and $\Phi$ is the equivalence
of Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma
\ref{perfect-lemma-affine-morphism-equivalence}.

final_content.statement: For a finite morphism $f:Y\to X$, set $\mathcal A=f_*\mathcal O_Y$ (a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-algebra). Let $\Phi:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)\simeq D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal A)$ denote the affine-morphism equivalence under which $Rf_*$ becomes restriction of scalars along $\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal A$. Denote the right derived $\mathcal A$-module-valued internal Hom functor by $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal A,-)$, viewed as an object of $D(\mathcal A)$. Assume $f:Y\to X$ is finite and pseudo-coherent. Then $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal A,-)$ maps $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal A)$. If $X$ is additionally quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let $a_f$ be the right adjoint of $Rf_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$; then the two functors $\Phi\circ a_f$ and $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal A,-)$ from $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal A)$ are naturally isomorphic. This is a bounded-below assertion, not a blanket unbounded derived-Hom identification.
hypotheses: f finite pseudo-coherent; X qcqs for comparison with right adjoint.
conclusions: Right adjoint for finite maps is derived sheaf Hom against f_*O_Y under the affine equivalence.
